name: Focused Kiai (Combat, Ki)
body:
You can channel the power of your kiai with great precision.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation, Improved Kiai, Kiai

Benefit(s): Your kiai deals additional sonic damage to your Wisdom modifier. In addition, you can shape the effect of your shout into a cone 10 feet long or a line 20 feet long per point you spend from your ki pool.
